name: Gaussian Splatting Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Gaussian Splatting Rasterization and Rendering Pipeline
definition: Orchestrates camera setup, SH evaluation, feature assembly, and Gaussian rasterization for a single view.
summary: The Gaussian Splatting Rendering Pipeline efficiently renders millions of 3D Gaussians into 2D images via differentiable rasterization, offering explicit, interactive scene representation distinct from polygon rasterization and NeRFs.
